title: The Queen Was the Price
setup: You gave up the queen on g3 last move, and White has no pawn left on f2 or h2.
hint: White has no pawn on f2 anymore. Find the piece that will cover that hole the moment it lands.
explanation:
## The Idea

With f2 and h2 gone, the h4–e1 diagonal belongs to Black. {{Bxg3#}} takes the last pawn on that road and nothing can recapture: the knight on g1 does not reach g3 and the rook on h1 is on the wrong line. f2 is the only flight square, and the bishop covers it.
